description: This file contains unit tests and supporting classes for testing an Event Hub stream provider with monitoring and cache pressure injection using Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderForMonitorTestsAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class extending EventDataGeneratorAdapterFactory, tailored for monitoring tests with cache pressure injection and monitor counters.

classes.name: CachePressureInjectionMonitor
classes.description: A monitor implementation that injects cache pressure status and tracks changes, used for testing cache pressure effects.

classes.name: CacheFactoryForMonitorTesting
classes.description: A custom cache factory used in tests that adds cache pressure monitors to caches.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of EHStreamProviderForMonitorTestsAdapterFactory using dependency injection services and configuration options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the stream provider, particularly setting the receiver monitor factory.

methods.name: ChangeCachePressure
methods.description: Toggles the cache pressure state for testing purposes.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory with monitoring for testing, injecting cache pressure monitors.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes management commands to retrieve monitor counters or change cache pressure state.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Placeholder for recording cache pressure contribution, no implementation here.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Returns whether the cache is under pressure, and logs status changes.
